title: AgentTask
description: Specification for a single unit of work assigned to a BibleFi agent or subagent within the agentic scripture-pipeline framework. Each agent operates in an isolated sandbox environment and communicates exclusively through AgentEnvelope-wrapped AgentTask records.

task_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this task (UUID v4).

schema_version.description: Semantic version of the AgentTask schema (e.g. '1.0.0').

agent_type.description: Category of agent performing this task. 'master' orchestrates the hourly pipeline; 'scripture_search' traverses the KJV for financially-themed passages; 'language_validator' cross-references original Hebrew, Greek, and Aramaic texts; 'theological_validator' consults concordances and dictionaries; 'dapp_seeder' formats and pushes validated records to the BibleFi dApp.

agent_id.description: Unique runtime identifier of the agent instance executing this task (e.g. 'master-agent-001', 'lang-validator-heb-02').

parent_task_id.description: UUID of the parent AgentTask that spawned this task. Absent for the root master task.

run_id.description: UUID of the AgentRunLog record this task belongs to. Links all tasks within a single hourly execution cycle.

sandbox_id.description: Identifier of the isolated sandbox environment in which this agent operates (e.g. a container ID or VM name). Agents must not share sandbox IDs to preserve isolation.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the task.

priority.description: Execution priority within the run (1 = lowest, 10 = highest). The master agent may set priorities to enforce ordering of subagent execution.

input.description: Agent-type-specific input parameters for this task. Schema varies by agent_type.

bible_book_range.description: Applicable to 'scripture_search' agents. Defines the portion of the Bible to scan in this task.

financial_keywords.description: List of financial theme keywords to match during scripture search (e.g. 'debt', 'money', 'wealth', 'tithe', 'stewardship', 'treasure', 'usury', 'mammon').

scripture_record_ids.description: UUIDs of ScriptureRecord documents to validate. Used by 'language_validator' and 'theological_validator' agents.

target_languages.description: Original-language corpora to consult during cross-language validation. Used by 'language_validator' agents.

seed_batch_id.description: UUID of the ScriptureSeedBatch to push to the dApp. Used by 'dapp_seeder' agents.

output.description: Agent-type-specific results produced by this task once completed.

scripture_record_ids.description: UUIDs of ScriptureRecord documents discovered or processed by this task.

validation_ids.description: UUIDs of CrossLanguageValidation or TheologicalValidation records produced by this task.

seed_batch_id.description: UUID of the ScriptureSeedBatch record created by a 'dapp_seeder' task.

records_processed.description: Total number of scripture records processed by this task.

records_accepted.description: Number of records that passed all validation checks.

records_rejected.description: Number of records rejected during this task's processing.

error.description: Error details if the task reached a 'failed' status.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

retryable.description: Whether the master agent should retry this task in the next cycle.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this task was created by the master agent.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the agent began executing the task.

completed_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the task reached a terminal state (completed, failed, or cancelled).

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this record was last updated.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for routing or observability (e.g. 'old-testament', 'new-testament', 'hebrew').
